rules.name: Roaming Performers
rules.description:
You may add one of the following Harlequins units to your Army List:
● TROUPE MASTER
● SHADOWSEER
and one of either:
● LIGHT TROUPE
● DARK TROUPE
● TWILIGHT TROUPE
If you do add one or more of those units to your Army List, your Army Rules gains Mocking Misstep, Allegro Advance, Prismatic Pirouette and Kaleidoscopic Cavalcade.

catalogue.comment:
ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS
Native non-Rare Other units use the soft 1/2/3 copy allowance. Each excess copy contributes +20 Points to the permanent Additional Copy Costs Configuration entry. Rare Other units retain their existing hard cap.

SPECIALIST / DEFAULT-EQUIPMENT CLEANUP
Named champions consume model slot 1; numbering therefore continues from model 2. Kabalite Trueborn 5 and Kabalite Warriors 9-10 are treated as dedicated special-weapon models and no longer advertise Splinter Rifle. Wrack 9-10 and Haemoxyte 5 no longer expose a None choice for their special weapon. Acothyst Stinger Pistols are represented as fixed default equipment.

CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR UX
Normal Leader missing-attachment errors, host attached-Leader limits, Rare copy limits, and Additional Copy Costs configuration protection use player-facing custom errors. Shared Game System validation handles Leader Capacity and Configuration-level missing Game Size / Additional Copy Costs validation. Lhamaean remains a nested attached Leader that may coexist with one normally attached Leader, and explicitly carries Counts Toward Leader Maximum so nested copies count toward Leader Capacity.

ROAMING PERFORMERS CONSTRUCTIVE VALIDATION
The five Drukhari-local Harlequin entryLinks remain hidden only while the Roaming Performers Configuration entry exists and Included is not selected. If Roaming Performers is deleted while a Harlequin unit is selected, the selected unit remains visible and reports a constructive error directing the player to restore Roaming Performers and select Included. This logic is Drukhari-local; the shared Harlequins library remains unaware of Roaming Performers.

REV18 NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Updated to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System revision 12. All Points cost references now use New Recruit's canonical Warhammer 40,000 cost-type identifier 51b2-306e-1021-d207. No unit costs, loadouts, validation, Roaming Performers logic, Harlequin library links, categories, or Additional Copy Costs arithmetic were otherwise changed.

REV19 POLISH PASS
Added explicit model/model-set headers to anonymous single-model and fixed-loadout units; renamed the four nested Lhamaean relationship groups to Attached Lhamaean while keeping them first in the affected unit layouts; flattened Kabalite Warrior, Wrack, Kabalite Trueborn, Haemoxyte, and Scourge specialist models into Loadout Options; renamed the two independent grenade selectors to Grenade and Additional Grenade; removed Talos Left Arm / Right Arm presentation labels; and standardized Haemonculus / Tantalus Rare error wording. Lhamaean Leader-capacity semantics, attachment rules, points, loadout legality, Roaming Performers, Harlequin library linkage, Additional Copy Costs, and all existing selection-entry names/IDs are otherwise unchanged.

REV20 INCUBI KLAIVEX LOADOUT
Removed the Klaive option from the Klaivex. The Klaivex is now always equipped with Demiklaives. The existing Demiklaives entry ID and the surrounding Klaivex loadout group are preserved; no other Incubi or Drukhari mechanics were changed.

REV21 RETROSPECTIVE POLISH PASS
Revisited Drukhari against the final cross-faction presentation standard. Standardized eight remaining host Leader-limit errors to grammar-safe 'This unit...' wording while preserving the four Lhamaean-aware exceptions exactly. Modernized the catalogue-level Constructive Error UX note to current Game System terminology and replaced obsolete Additional Leader terminology for the Lhamaean with nested attached Leader terminology. Loadouts, Attached Lhamaean ordering and mechanics, Roaming Performers, Harlequin linkage, Rare validation, points, categories, Additional Copy Costs, Incubi/Klaivex equipment, and all other rules semantics remain unchanged.

REV22 — REAVER ATOMIC LOADOUTS
Collapsed Reavers into final-state equipment packages. Arena Champion now shows fixed Splinter Rifle & Bladevanes and chooses Power Sword & Splinter Pistol / Agoniser & Splinter Pistol. Reaver 2 chooses Splinter Rifle & Bladevanes, Heat Lance & Bladevanes, or Blaster & Bladevanes. Reaver 3 now shows fixed Splinter Rifle & Bladevanes. Obsolete standalone Bladevanes and Splinter Pistol branches were removed rather than retained as dead-ID shells.

REV23 — SCOURGE SOLARITE ATOMIC LOADOUTS
Collapsed the Solarite's fixed Power Lance into both pistol choices. Solarite now chooses Splinter Pistol & Power Lance or Blast Pistol & Power Lance. The obsolete standalone Power Lance group was removed rather than retained as dead-ID debris.

REV24 — GROTESQUE ATOMIC LOADOUTS
Collapsed each Grotesque model's fixed Flesh Gauntlet into its meaningful weapon choice. Grotesque 1, 2, and 3 now each choose Liquifier Gun & Flesh Gauntlet or Monstrous Cleaver & Flesh Gauntlet. Removed the redundant standalone Flesh Gauntlet groups. Model independence, points, categories, Additional Copy Costs, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

REV25 — HAEMOXYTE ATOMIC LOADOUTS
Collapsed Haemoxytes into final-state equipment packages. Acothyst now chooses Acothyst Tools & Stinger Pistol, Venom Blade & Stinger Pistol, or Electrocorrosive Whip & Stinger Pistol. Haemoxytes 2-4 now use the literal 3x Wracks Blade package. Haemoxyte 5 now chooses Liquifier Gun & Wracks Blade, Ossefactor & Wracks Blade, or Hexrifle & Wracks Blade. Removed the redundant standalone Stinger Pistol and Wrack Blades groups. Points, categories, Additional Copy Costs, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

REV26 — BLOODBRIDE BASELINE PACKAGE
Collapsed Hekatrix Bloodbrides 2-5 into one literal fixed package, 4x Hekatarii Blades & Splinter Pistol. Removed the redundant standalone 4x Splinter Pistol group. All other Hekatrix Bloodbrides mechanics are unchanged.

REV27 — WRACK ATOMIC LOADOUTS
Applied final-state loadout packaging to Wracks. Acothyst now folds its fixed Stinger Pistol into Acothyst Tools, Venom Blade, and Electrocorrosive Whip. Wracks 9 and 10 now fold their fixed Wrack Blades into Liquifier Gun, Ossefactor, and Hexrifle packages. Removed the redundant fixed branches. Wracks 2-8, points, categories, Additional Copy Costs, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

REV28 — WYCH BASELINE PACKAGE
Collapsed Wyches 2-10 into one literal fixed package, 9x Hekatarii Blades & Splinter Pistol. Removed the redundant standalone 9x Splinter Pistol group. All other Wyches mechanics are unchanged.
